the role of familiarity in implicit and explicit memory tasks in young, middle-age, and older adults.
the nature of the cognitive processes involved in implicit and explicit memory performance.
the nature of age-related changes in the ability to retrieve words from memory.

age-related deficits in implicit and explicit memory are not due to an inability to search for information in long-term memory, but rather are due to a reliance on familiarity as an index of target memory.
